# Plum: a pink-purple egg 0.32 m across, 0.4 m tall.
# Origin at the fruit's centre (a game bone pool: the game drops, catches and pops it).
new
material new Body --base-color 0.8118 0.5412 0.7961 --no-slot
material new Stem --base-color 0.2941 0.2549 0.3451 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Fruit --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.16 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 1.25
apply --scale
material assign Body
add mesh cube --name Stalk --size 1 --location 0.02 0 0.250
scale 0.06 0.06 0.14
apply --scale
material assign Stem
select all
active Fruit
join
select all
shade flat
export plum.glb
